sentences.en: I thought it strange that the petition had been turned down.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这个请愿被拒绝很奇怪。

sentences.en: We hope that you all will sign this petition.
sentences.zh: 我们希望你们都能在这份请愿书上签名。

sentences.en: We need to get more signatures on this petition.
sentences.zh: 我们需要在这个请愿书上获得更多的签名。

senses.zh: 请愿；请愿书；祈求；[法] 诉状

mnemonic: 词根记忆：pet（寻求）+ition→力争实现要求→请愿
